issue.title: Fix Record Tab Scrolling to Move as One Page Instead of Independently Scrolling Sections
issue.body: The Record tab's take list and Source Text section each scroll independently inside their own containers. When enough takes exist for a unit, earlier takes scroll out of view at the top of the take list before later takes are visible, and the same clipping happens to the Source Text section when it is long. This ticket replaces the nested independent scrolling with a single scrollable page, so a translator can see all content by scrolling normally instead of discovering it's hidden inside a nested scroll area. ## Functional Requirements ### Verse Navigation Bar - Keep the verse title (e.g., "Genesis 3:3") with the previous/next navigation arrows pinned at the top of the Record tab; it does not move when the rest of the tab content scrolls. ### Page Content - Combine the take list and Source Text section into a single scrollable region below the verse navigation bar. - Remove independent scrolling from the take list and source text; each renders at its full height and scrolls only as part of the page. - When the combined height of the take list, "Record New Take" button, and Source Text section exceeds the visible viewport, scroll the whole page rather than clipping or independently scrolling any one section. Note: The screenshot shows the reported bug: Take 1 has scrolled off the top of the take list's own scroll container while the rest of the page still has room below.

comments.body:
**Test Results – #404**
Tested this ticket from nightly build

- Verse Navigation Bar – The verse title and previous/next navigation arrows remain pinned at the top of the Record tab while scrolling through the page content.
- Single Page Scrolling – The Take List, Record New Take button, and Source Text section scroll together as one continuous page.
- Take List Scrolling – The Take List no longer scrolls independently, and all takes can be accessed by scrolling the main page.
- Source Text Scrolling – The Source Text section no longer has independent scrolling and is fully accessible through the main page scroll.
- Content Visibility – Earlier takes, later takes, and long Source Text are not clipped or hidden inside separate scroll containers.
- Continuous Scrolling – Scrolling smoothly continues from the Take List to the Record New Take button and then to the Source Text section.
- Long Content Handling – When the combined content exceeds the visible screen height, the entire page scrolls correctly without clipping any section.
- Navigation Accessibility – The previous and next navigation arrows remain visible and accessible even when the user scrolls to the bottom of the page.


**Issues Identified**

- Waveform Alignment Issue – When the user clicks the Record button, the waveform moves toward the left while the other recording controls remain centrally aligned.
- Audio Error After Pause – When the user pauses the recording for a few seconds or locks the screen, an audio error appears and prevents the user from continuing the recording.

The issues mentioned have been reported separately, and new tickets #485 and #486 have been created for tracking.


**Moving this ticket to passedQA**
